en.content: The correct structure of ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) is
en.explanation:
EDTA (ethylenediaminetetracetic acid) is a hexadentate ligand. It is also called the amino poly-carboxylic acid.

It is structure consists of the ethane group which is attached to tertiary amine groups at the terminal positions forming an ethylene diamine. Tertiary amine group is situated by the acetic acid groups .
